description.message: CSS Insight - quick CSS inspection, analysis, editing and one-click copying on webpages. A practical tool for web developers.

nomedia.message: No media rules for that resource.

waserror.message: A stylesheet could not be read because of cross-origin restrictions.

emptyrule.message: Enter a CSS rule before applying it.

stylesapplied.message: CSS preview applied. Applying another rule replaces it.

pickinstruction.message: Switch to any webpage in this window, then click or tap an element.

pickerexpired.message: Element picker timed out. Start it again when ready.

pickertimeout.message: The element picker did not respond in time. Try again.

picktooltip.message: Click or tap an element to select it

pageaccessprotected.message: CSS Insight cannot run on browser-internal or protected pages.

pageaccessmozilla.message: Firefox does not allow extensions to inspect this protected Mozilla page.

pageaccessfile.message: Firefox could not access this local file.

operationfailed.message: CSS Insight could not complete the operation.

targetunavailable.message: The selected frame or open shadow root is no longer available.

activepageselected.message: The active page is now the inspection target.

nostylespreview.message: No CSS preview is active for this target.

updatefeaturelocales.message: Localized popup and update information in six languages.

updatefeaturetarget.message: Visible target context with a one-click reset to the active page.

updatefeaturepreview.message: CSS previews can be removed without reloading the page.

updatefeatureaccessibility.message: More reliable keyboard focus in the on-page details dialog.

updatetippicker.message: Select Pick an Element, switch to a supported webpage in the same window, then click or tap an element.

updatetiprule.message: Use Apply Rule to test custom CSS. Remove Preview restores the page without a reload.
